chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this hadith to articulate the Shia doctrine of *al-Nazar al-Husn* (good expectation) regarding Allah, emphasizing that God’s perception is inherently pure and devoid of defect. This attribute underscores the divine benevolence that underpins creation, serving as a theological basis for believers to maintain a positive spiritual outlook (*husn al-zann*) toward their Creator.
